description: This file contains functions and classes related to computing and analyzing time budgets for behaviors in a behavioral observation project. It includes utilities for initializing behavior data, computing standard deviations in SQL, and generating synthetic time budget datasets based on observations. It also provides analysis functions for extracting counts, durations, and statistics of behaviors, possibly categorized by behavior types or categories.

classes.name: StdevFunc
classes.description: A class to compute sample standard deviation incrementally, designed for SQL aggregate functions.

methods.name: default_value(ethogram: dict, behavior_code: str, param)
methods.description: Returns the default duration value for point or state events based on behavior type and parameters.

methods.name: dict init_behav_modif(ethogram: dict, selected_subjects: list, distinct_behav_modif: list, parameters: dict)
methods.description: Initializes a nested dictionary for behavior modifications across subjects with default values.

methods.name: dict init_behav_modif_bin(ethogram: dict, selected_subjects: list, distinct_behav_modif: list, parameters: dict)
methods.description: Initializes a nested dictionary for behavior modifications in binary form across subjects with default values.

methods.name: StdevFunc.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the object with zeroed accumulators for mean and variance calculation.

methods.name: StdevFunc.step
methods.description: Ingests a new value for incremental standard deviation calculation, ignoring None values.

methods.name: StdevFunc.finalize
methods.description: Computes and returns the sample standard deviation if at least 3 values have been processed.

methods.name: synthetic_time_budget_bin(pj: dict, selected_observations: list, parameters_obs: dict)
methods.description: Generates a synthetic time budget divided into time bins for given observations, behaviors, and behaviors modifiers, returning a dataset.

methods.name: synthetic_time_budget(pj: dict, selected_observations: list, parameters_obs: dict)
methods.description: Creates a synthetic overall time budget dataset for selected observations and behaviors.

methods.name: Tuple[list,dict] time_budget_analysis( ethogram: dict, cursor, selected_observations: list, parameters: dict, by_category: bool = False )
methods.description: Performs detailed analysis extracting counts, durations, mean, and standard deviations of behaviors, optionally grouped by category.
